customer_message: Hi, I was charged again after renewal and I want a refund. This is urgent because I cannot afford the duplicate charge right now. My order ID is A-4812.
policy_excerpt: Frontline can approve a standard refund during the renewal grace window. If a charge is still pending, the agent should clarify the posting state before promising a refund. Manager review is only required for non-standard exceptions.
